bio.text: Rebecca A. Seawright represents the 76th Assembly District, covering the Upper East Side, Yorkville and Roosevelt Island in Manhattan, and has done so since her 2014 election.
She is the first woman to serve the district and was appointed Chair of the Assembly's Aging Committee in 2025.
She previously chaired the People with Disabilities Committee and the Task Force on Women's Issues.
She formerly chaired the board of the Feminist Press at the City University of New York for eight years and currently chairs the CUNY Law School Board of Visitors.
